text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each row is the first arm minus the second on the quantile score over all leads; below zero favours the first arm. Grey line: no difference. Orange dashed line: the 0.30-point margin. C1 to C3 and C5 to C7 use the 16 Primary substations; the others use all 20 series. 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026, ENS weather. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.44% interval (Bonferroni across the nine planned contrasts) from re- drawing whole months and seeds.'
